verdict.rationale: Glama's MCP Inspector lets users interactively test any MCP server's tools, resources, prompts, and sampling from the browser, which functions as a runnable, hands-on reference for MCP capabilities, and server pages include pre-filled config blocks to copy. However, probes show no traditional interactive API reference (OpenAPI/Swagger docs 404, no docs.md) for Glama's own API, so the story is only partially satisfied via the MCP-specific tool rather than a full API reference experience. Missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/Swagger-style interactive reference for Glama's own APIs, confirmed runnable code snippets beyond MCP tool invocation, and independent corroboration of the Inspector's usability.
